jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Our Vision

Health systems still run critical operations like staffing, labor planning, and capacity on spreadsheets, phone calls, and guesswork.

Vitalize is building the AI operating system for how health systems manage labor and capacity. The impact is real: we save hospitals millions in unnecessary labor spend, give clinical leaders back 10–20 hours every week, and are often the reason staff and leaders stay.

We’re trusted by leading health systems across the country and have raised more than $31M from top healthcare and technology investors, including our own custo


Our Values

We hire and grow everyone against the same four values. Each one comes from a real Vitalize story—interview with us to hear them!

  • 🚗 Push the Car. Step in regardless of role. We help wherever we're needed, own problems end to end, and don't stay in our lane. People can count on us.

  • 🏥 Premier 1K. We show up for our customers, always. Nearly everyone visits a customer site in their first month, and customer feedback informs everything we do.

  • 🗣️ Run Towards the Ugly. Name the ugliest truth first, then propose the fix. Candor over comfort—we call out what's broken, and never get complacent. This shapes our craft.

  • 💡 Think Bigger Fridays. See the gap, fill it—no permission required. Every decision is an experiment: we run it, let the results decide, and drive real impact from day one.

About Vitalize’s Deployment Team

Our team is the engine behind Vitalize's growth as we scale our deployment motion from 30 to 300+ hospitals. We own the most complex, highest-stakes enterprise rollouts, and our work directly shapes how new product lines and expansions land with customers. These are the moments that unlock multi-million-dollar ARR, long-term customer success, measurable ROI, and most importantly, real impact for the clinicians and staff using Vitalize every day.

The Role

You’ll embed directly with nursing executives, hospital operations leaders, finance, and IT to understand how their organizations actually function—not just how they think they function. You’ll diagnose operational bottlenecks, align cross-functional stakeholders, drive organizational change, and architect deployments that fundamentally reshape how health systems staff and operate. For our customers, you aren’t just implementing software—you are the face of Vitalize and a trusted advisor helping them transform one of the most operationally complex environments in healthcare.


What You’ll Do

  • Own complex, multi-month deployments end to end, managing timelines, milestones, dependencies, and risks across several health systems at once so every go-live lands on time and delivers results

  • Become a trusted advisor to C-suite executives, nursing leaders, and operational stakeholders as they redesign how labor is planned, staffed, and managed across their health systems

  • Align executives and cross-functional stakeholders across nursing, operations, IT, finance, HR, PMO, labor relations, and legal, keeping everyone clear on decisions, owners, and next steps through enterprise-wide go-lives

  • Design and continuously refine repeatable deployment playbooks for academic medical centers and complex, multi-union health systems

  • Develop a predictable launch motion for new system integrations, including greenfield HRIS and payroll builds

  • Partner directly with GTM and Customer Success on the internal flows, tools, and processes that drive long-term client success

  • Work with Product, Design, and Engineering to build and iterate on new product lines, driving ARR growth through expansion

 

What You’ll Bring

  • Clear communication: You communicate with clarity and confidence across every audience, from frontline clinicians to C-suite executives. You simplify complex ideas, navigate difficult conversations, and build alignment proactively

  • Deployment and project management expertise: You’ve managed complex, cross-functional deployments from planning through go-live. You anticipate risks, prioritize well, and bring structure to ambiguous, fast-moving environments

  • Credibility with clinical teams: You partner with nurses, physicians, and hospital staff as a consultant, not just a project manager. You listen first, learn their workflows, and earn trust by solving problems alongside the people doing the work every day

  • Change management experience: You know successful deployments depend on people, not just technology. You spot resistance early, build buy-in across stakeholder groups, and help organizations adopt new ways of working

  • A strong sense of ownership: You take initiative without waiting for direction, thrive when things change quickly, and always look for ways to improve processes and move work forward

Benefits

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Flexible PTO

  • Unlimited travel budget to visit customer sites

  • Twice-yearly company off-sites

  • Free meals in the office

  • $5,000 relocation bonus for eligible employees

  • Desk setup reimbursement

  • Commuter benefits

  • Monthly gym/wellness stipend

  • An awesome office in Jackson Square, steps from the water

  • 💡 Think Bigger Fridays. See the gap, fill it—no permission required. Every decision is an experiment: we run it, let the results decide, and drive real impact from day one.

About Vitalize's Customer Success Team

Customer Success turns successful deployments into durable, growing partnerships. We own adoption, value realization, executive relationships, retention, and identifying opportunities to expand Vitalize across the health systems we serve.

Our CSMs become experts in their customers’ operations—working from the frontline to the C-suite to understand what matters, prove measurable ROI, and help health systems get more value from Vitalize over time. As our customer base grows, Customer Success will be central to making Vitalize an indispensable strategic partner to every health system we serve.

The Role

You’ll join Vitalize’s early Customer Success team and own a portfolio of ~5–7 enterprise health systems. These are complex, multi-hospital organizations where Vitalize is deployed across thousands of frontline users and works with stakeholders from nurse managers to C-suite executives.

You’ll own the customer lifecycle from contract signature onward — partnering closely with Deployments through implementation and go-live, then leading the long-term relationship across workforce transformation, adoption, value realization, executive engagement, retention, and expansion. You’ll also work closely with Customer Support to ensure issues are resolved quickly and systematically.

As an early member of the team, you won’t just manage accounts. You’ll help define how Customer Success operates as Vitalize scales: what great account management looks like, how we measure and communicate value, and how we turn successful customers into durable, reference-able partnerships.

What You'll Do

  • Own the end-to-end success motion for assigned health systems—from deployment handoff through adoption, value realization, and renewal

  • Build and maintain multi-threaded relationships across each account: C-suite sponsors, operational directors, and frontline champions

  • Run QBRs and executive check-ins that are grounded in data and tied to customer-specific KPIs

  • Act as a strategic consultant on workforce strategy—helping leaders connect Vitalize data to decisions on OT reduction, float pool optimization, and labor spend

  • Build ROI narratives that quantify the value Vitalize delivers (financial savings, operational efficiency, workforce outcomes), tailored to the audience (CFO, CNO, operations director)

  • Drive adoption across complex, multi-site organizations with non-tech-savvy users and competing priorities

  • Design ongoing education and training motions—not just initial rollout, but sustained engagement that keeps utilization high

  • Own the hard conversations when value isn't landing as expected, and work cross-functionally to course-correct

  • Translate customer conversations into actionable product insight—distinguish between custom configuration and productizable features, and bring structured feedback to the product team

  • Partner with Deployments to ensure clean handoffs, track leading indicators during go-lives, and embed early in new customer sites

  • Collaborate with Analytics to tailor reporting packages per account and ensure the right data is powering your executive conversations

  • Work with Support to surface systemic issues and ensure customer health isn't eroding below the surface

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years managing enterprise accounts or complex stakeholder environments—CS, consulting, implementation, or healthcare ops

  • Executive presence—you can run meetings with C-suite health system leaders, manage expectations, and have hard conversations about value delivery

  • Analytical rigor—you build ROI narratives from data, use metrics as leading indicators, and create reports that drive action (not just updates)

  • Multi-threading instinct—you naturally build relationships across stakeholder tiers (executive sponsor, operational leads, frontline champions) and tailor your approach to each

  • Startup mindset—you've operated in a high-growth, ambiguous environment where playbooks didn't exist and you had to build the motion

  • Willingness to travel—50% initially (customer site visits during deployments), 25% ongoing


Benefits

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Flexible PTO

  • Unlimited travel budget to visit customer sites

  • Twice-yearly company off-sites

  • Free meals in the office

  • $5,000 relocation bonus for eligible employees

  • Desk setup reimbursement

  • Commuter benefits

  • Monthly gym/wellness stipend

  • An awesome office in Jackson Square, steps from the water

About Vitalize

Our Vision: Unlock Healthcare's Full Capacity

Health systems still run critical operations like staffing, labor planning, and capacity on spreadsheets, phone calls, and guesswork.

Vitalize is building the AI operating system for how health systems manage labor and capacity. The impact is real: we save hospitals millions in unnecessary labor spend, give clinical leaders back 10–20 hours every week, and are often the reason staff and leaders stay.

We’re trusted by leading health systems across the country and have raised more than $31M from top healthcare and technology investors, including our own customers.


Our Values

We hire and grow everyone against the same four values. Each one comes from a real Vitalize story—interview with us to hear them!

  • 🚗 Push the Car. Step in regardless of role. We help wherever we're needed, own problems end to end, and don't stay in our lane. People can count on us.

  • 🏥 Premier 1K. We show up for our customers, always. Nearly everyone visits a customer site in their first month, and customer feedback informs everything we do.

  • 🗣️ Run Towards the Ugly. Name the ugliest truth first, then propose the fix. Candor over comfort—we call out what's broken, and never get complacent. This shapes our craft.

  • 💡 Think Bigger Fridays. See the gap, fill it—no permission required. Every decision is an experiment: we run it, let the results decide, and drive real impact from day one.

 

About Vitalize’s Engineering Team

Every recommendation Vitalize makes flows through this team. We build the intelligence that helps hospitals decide who should float, when to call someone in, when staffing is becoming unsafe, and eventually when the system can safely make those decisions on its own.

This is where Vitalize evolves from software that reports what’s happening into software that actively runs hospital operations.

 

The Role

Clinical leaders make hundreds of staffing decisions every day under time pressure using disconnected systems. We’re replacing that with software that reasons through the problem, recommends, and eventually executes the best next actions.

You’ll own the decision engine behind those recommendations, turning messy operational reality into software customers trust with some of the most important decisions inside a hospital.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Design and build the decision logic behind staffing recommendations, alerts, and workflows

  • Own systems that balance staffing rules, hospital policies, patient needs, and operational constraints

  • Partner with our Product Managers, Designers, and other Engineers to build complex software solutions that are easy for our customers to use

  • Work directly with clinical leaders to understand how staffing decisions are made

  • Build software that explains why it reached a recommendation so users can trust, validate, or override it

  • Define where automation ends and human judgment begins, helping Vitalize safely automate more hospital operations over time

  • Continuously improve the system using customer feedback, production data, and real-world outcomes

 

What You’ll Bring

  • Technical expertise—You have expertise with TypeScript

  • Problem-solving instinct—You instinctively dive into the why

  • Full-stack experience—You have experience working across the entire tech stack

  • Systems thinking—You can reason through complicated edge cases

  • Customer orientation—You’re comfortable working directly with customers to understand problems and rapidly improve the product

  • Ownership and communication—You communicate clearly and take strong ownership of your work

 

Our Stack

Bun • TypeScript • Effect • React • TanStack Router • PlanetScale

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Flexible PTO

  • Unlimited travel budget to visit customer sites

  • Free meals in the office

About Vitalize's Talent Team

The Talent Team will determine how quickly Vitalize scales and how much impact we can have on healthcare. Every great hire helps us deploy faster, build better products, serve more hospitals, and ultimately improve the way care is delivered.

We're building what we believe will become one of the best talent teams in the world. We don't believe great recruiting starts with a job description; it starts with deeply understanding our customers, the problems we're solving, and the teams we're building. Our recruiters sit in on customer calls, travel to customer sites, partner closely with hiring teams, and immerse themselves in the business so they can recruit with credibility. As one of our founding recruiters, you'll help build our talent function from the ground up and shape how Vitalize hires for years to come.


The Role

This isn't a traditional recruiting coordinator role. You'll be the operational backbone of our Talent team as we scale and build—the person constantly looking for better ways to hire. When you see friction, you fix it. When you notice repetitive work, you automate it. When a process doesn't scale, you build one that does. You find satisfaction in making complex things feel effortless.

You'll become our in-house Ashby expert, pushing the platform beyond the basics by building automations, creating thoughtful interview kits, improving workflows, leveraging AI, and ensuring every part of our hiring process gets a little better every week. You're the type of person who loves tinkering with systems and is always asking, "There has to be a better way to do this."

You'll also own some of the most important moments in a candidate's and employee's journey. Whether it's creating a seamless interview experience or ensuring every new hire has an incredible first day, you sweat the small details because you know they're what people remember.

Finally, we believe sourcing is one of the highest-leverage skills in recruiting, and we want everyone on our Talent team to learn it. We'll teach you how to identify exceptional talent, build talent maps, develop thoughtful outreach strategies, and proactively engage candidates long before they're looking for their next opportunity. Over time, you'll become one of our secret weapons—not because you manage the process, but because you consistently help us find incredible people.


What You'll Do

  • Own interview operations across the company, ensuring every interview is thoughtfully coordinated and every candidate has an exceptional experience

  • Become the internal expert on Ashby. Build automations, workflows, interview plans, templates, interview kits, dashboards, and reporting that make recruiting faster, smarter, and more scalable

  • Continuously identify opportunities to leverage AI and technology to eliminate manual work, improve quality, and create leverage for the Talent team

  • Own the operational excellence of our Talent function. If there's friction in our hiring process, you'll identify it, fix it, and build a better way

  • Partner with recruiters to build interview kits, standardize scorecards, and ensure interviewers have the tools they need to make exceptional hiring decisions

  • Maintain high data quality across Ashby so reporting, candidate data, interview feedback, and recruiting metrics remain accurate and actionable

  • Build recruiting dashboards that help us understand funnel conversion, hiring velocity, interviewer health, and where we can improve

  • Evaluate and implement new recruiting technologies that help us hire better and faster

  • Own the onboarding experience from offer acceptance through day one, partnering with hiring managers, IT, Facilities, and People Operations to ensure every new hire has a seamless first-day experience

  • Create memorable candidate touchpoints throughout the interview process so every candidate—whether hired or not—leaves impressed by the way Vitalize hires

  • Learn sourcing and talent identification, eventually becoming a trusted sourcing partner who proactively uncovers top-tier talent for our highest-priority searches

What You'll Bring

  • Recruiting operations experience—You have 2+ years of Recruiting Coordination, Recruiting Operations, or Talent Operations experience in a fast-paced environment

  • Ashby expertise— You know how to build automations, configure workflows, create interview plans, write interview kits, generate reporting, and continuously improve how recruiting operates

  • Process and operational excellence—You naturally identify inefficiencies and enjoy building systems that make teams more effective

  • Exceptional attention to detail—You catch the things other people miss and consistently deliver a polished, thoughtful experience

  • A hospitality mindset—You make every interaction with a candidate, interviewer, hiring manager, or new hire feels organized, intentional, and leaves people feeling genuinely cared for

  • Curiosity around AI and recruiting technology—You're constantly looking for ways to automate repetitive work, improve quality, and create leverage for the Talent team

  • Strong project management skills—You can manage multiple priorities without sacrificing quality

  • Exceptional judgment—You know when to move quickly, when to escalate issues, and how to represent Vitalize professionally in every interaction

  • High agency—You don't wait for someone else to identify a problem-you proactively solve it

  • A growth mindset—You're excited to learn sourcing and develop into someone who can identify, engage, and attract exceptional talent-not just coordinate interviews

We spend time in hospitals, learn how work happens from the frontline to the C-suite, and use those insights to design products that make complex operational decisions easier. We care deeply about craft, but we believe great design starts with getting the workflow right—not just the interface. As a small team, we work closely with Product and Engineering, share work early, challenge each other’s thinking, and stay close to the customers using what we build.

The Role

You’ll be the third product designer at Vitalize, joining at a stage where you’ll have significant ownership and room to shape the product. You’ll lead design for complex product areas from early discovery through launch, working alongside product managers and engineers to turn ambiguous problems into clear, intuitive experiences. You’ll design across data-dense and AI-powered workflows, contribute to our growing design system, and help establish a consistently high bar for the experiences we ship as Vitalize scales.

What You'll Do

  • Own product design from discovery through launch—partner with Product and Engineering to understand problems, explore solutions, prototype ideas, and ship high-quality experiences

  • Design complex, workflow-heavy product experiences—make data-dense operational tools intuitive for users ranging from central staffing teams and unit managers to frontline clinicians

  • Work directly with customers—visit hospitals, observe real workflows, participate in research, and translate what you learn into better product decisions

  • Bring strong product thinking to the work—question the underlying workflow, identify opportunities beyond the immediate request, and connect design decisions to customer and business outcomes

  • Design thoughtful AI-powered experiences—help determine where AI can meaningfully improve workflows and how its recommendations, reasoning, and actions should appear in the product

  • Contribute to and evolve our design system—create reusable components and patterns, improve consistency across the product, and partner with engineering to ensure designs translate effectively into production

  • Raise the quality of the work around you—participate actively in critique, share thoughtful feedback, and contribute to the practices that help our small design team do its best work

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years of product design experience, ideally designing complex, workflow-heavy B2B SaaS products, with a portfolio demonstrating meaningful ownership from problem definition through shipped product

  • Strong product instincts and design craft—you look beyond the immediate UI, question whether the underlying workflow is right, and turn complicated problems into intuitive experiences

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills—you form and articulate a point of view, incorporate evidence and feedback, and work through disagreement effectively with product managers and engineers

  • Experience contributing to design systems—you understand reusable components and patterns and care about building consistency and quality into the product as it scales

  • AI fluency—you’ve designed AI-powered experiences or have a strong understanding of how AI changes product interactions, with a thoughtful perspective on where AI should and shouldn’t be part of a workflow

Our team is the engine behind Vitalize's growth as we scale our deployment motion from 30 to 300+ hospitals. We own the most complex, highest-stakes enterprise rollouts, and our work directly shapes how new product lines and expansions land with customers. These are the moments that unlock multi-million-dollar ARR, long-term customer success, measurable ROI, and most importantly, real impact for the clinicians and staff using Vitalize every day.

The Role

You’ll embed directly with nursing executives, hospital operations leaders, finance, and IT to understand how their organizations actually function—not just how they think they function. You’ll diagnose operational bottlenecks, align cross-functional stakeholders, drive organizational change, and architect deployments that fundamentally reshape how health systems staff and operate. For our customers, you aren’t just implementing software—you are the face of Vitalize and a trusted advisor helping them transform one of the most operationally complex environments in healthcare.


What You’ll Do

  • Own complex, multi-month deployments end to end, managing timelines, milestones, dependencies, and risks across several health systems at once so every go-live lands on time and delivers results

  • Become a trusted advisor to C-suite executives, nursing leaders, and operational stakeholders as they redesign how labor is planned, staffed, and managed across their health systems

  • Align executives and cross-functional stakeholders across nursing, operations, IT, finance, HR, PMO, labor relations, and legal, keeping everyone clear on decisions, owners, and next steps through enterprise-wide go-lives

  • Design and continuously refine repeatable deployment playbooks for academic medical centers and complex, multi-union health systems

  • Develop a predictable launch motion for new system integrations, including greenfield HRIS and payroll builds

  • Partner directly with GTM and Customer Success on the internal flows, tools, and processes that drive long-term client success

  • Work with Product, Design, and Engineering to build and iterate on new product lines, driving ARR growth through expansion

 

What You’ll Bring

  • Clear communication: You communicate with clarity and confidence across every audience, from frontline clinicians to C-suite executives. You simplify complex ideas, navigate difficult conversations, and build alignment proactively

  • Deployment and project management expertise: You’ve managed complex, cross-functional deployments from planning through go-live. You anticipate risks, prioritize well, and bring structure to ambiguous, fast-moving environments

  • Credibility with clinical teams: You partner with nurses, physicians, and hospital staff as a consultant, not just a project manager. You listen first, learn their workflows, and earn trust by solving problems alongside the people doing the work every day

  • Change management experience: You know successful deployments depend on people, not just technology. You spot resistance early, build buy-in across stakeholder groups, and help organizations adopt new ways of working

  • A strong sense of ownership: You take initiative without waiting for direction, thrive when things change quickly, and always look for ways to improve processes and move work forward

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Flexible PTO

  • Unlimited travel budget to visit customer sites

  • Twice-yearly company off-sites

  • Free meals in the office

  • $5,000 relocation bonus for eligible employees

  • Desk setup reimbursement

  • Commuter benefits

  • Monthly gym/wellness stipend

Health systems still run critical operations like staffing, labor planning, and capacity on spreadsheets, phone calls, and guesswork.

Vitalize is building the AI operating system for how health systems manage labor and capacity. The impact is real: we save hospitals millions in unnecessary labor spend, give clinical leaders back 10–20 hours every week, and are often the reason staff and leaders stay.

We’re trusted by leading health systems across the country and have raised more than $31M from top healthcare and technology investors, including our own custo



OUR VALUES

We hire and grow everyone against the same four values. Each one comes from a real Vitalize story—interview with us to hear them!

 - 🚗 Push the Car. Step in regardless of role. We help wherever we're needed, own problems end to end, and don't stay in our lane. People can count on us.

 - 🏥 Premier 1K. We show up for our customers, always. Nearly everyone visits a customer site in their first month, and customer feedback informs everything we do.

 - 🗣️ Run Towards the Ugly. Name the ugliest truth first, then propose the fix. Candor over comfort—we call out what's broken, and never get complacent. This shapes our craft.

 - 💡 Think Bigger Fridays. See the gap, fill it—no permission required. Every decision is an experiment: we run it, let the results decide, and drive real impact from day one.




ABOUT VITALIZE’S DEPLOYMENT TEAM

Our team is the engine behind Vitalize's growth as we scale our deployment motion from 30 to 300+ hospitals. We own the most complex, highest-stakes enterprise rollouts, and our work directly shapes how new product lines and expansions land with customers. These are the moments that unlock multi-million-dollar ARR, long-term customer success, measurable ROI, and most importantly, real impact for the clinicians and staff using Vitalize every day.




THE ROLE

You’ll embed directly with nursing executives, hospital operations leaders, finance, and IT to understand how their organizations actually function—not just how they think they function. You’ll diagnose operational bottlenecks, align cross-functional stakeholders, drive organizational change, and architect deployments that fundamentally reshape how health systems staff and operate. For our customers, you aren’t just implementing software—you are the face of Vitalize and a trusted advisor helping them transform one of the most operationally complex environments in healthcare.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own complex, multi-month deployments end to end, managing timelines, milestones, dependencies, and risks across several health systems at once so every go-live lands on time and delivers results

 - Become a trusted advisor to C-suite executives, nursing leaders, and operational stakeholders as they redesign how labor is planned, staffed, and managed across their health systems

 - Align executives and cross-functional stakeholders across nursing, operations, IT, finance, HR, PMO, labor relations, and legal, keeping everyone clear on decisions, owners, and next steps through enterprise-wide go-lives

 - Design and continuously refine repeatable deployment playbooks for academic medical centers and complex, multi-union health systems

 - Develop a predictable launch motion for new system integrations, including greenfield HRIS and payroll builds

 - Partner directly with GTM and Customer Success on the internal flows, tools, and processes that drive long-term client success

 - Work with Product, Design, and Engineering to build and iterate on new product lines, driving ARR growth through expansion

 


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - Clear communication: You communicate with clarity and confidence across every audience, from frontline clinicians to C-suite executives. You simplify complex ideas, navigate difficult conversations, and build alignment proactively

 - Deployment and project management expertise: You’ve managed complex, cross-functional deployments from planning through go-live. You anticipate risks, prioritize well, and bring structure to ambiguous, fast-moving environments

 - Credibility with clinical teams: You partner with nurses, physicians, and hospital staff as a consultant, not just a project manager. You listen first, learn their workflows, and earn trust by solving problems alongside the people doing the work every day

 - Change management experience: You know successful deployments depend on people, not just technology. You spot resistance early, build buy-in across stakeholder groups, and help organizations adopt new ways of working

 - A strong sense of ownership: You take initiative without waiting for direction, thrive when things change quickly, and always look for ways to improve processes and move work forward




BENEFITS

 - Medical, dental, and vision insurance

 - 401(k) with company match

 - Flexible PTO

 - Unlimited travel budget to visit customer sites

 - Twice-yearly company off-sites

 - Free meals in the office

 - $5,000 relocation bonus for eligible employees

 - Desk setup reimbursement

 - Commuter benefits

 - Monthly gym/wellness stipend

 - An awesome office in Jackson Square, steps from the water

  • 🚗 Push the Car. Step in regardless of role. We help wherever we're needed, own problems end to end, and don't stay in our lane. People can count on us.

  • 🏥 Premier 1K. We show up for our customers, always. Nearly everyone visits a customer site in their first month, and customer feedback informs everything we do.

  • 🗣️ Run Towards the Ugly. Name the ugliest truth first, then propose the fix. Candor over comfort — we call out what's broken, and never get complacent. This shapes our craft.

  • 💡 Think Bigger Fridays. See the gap, fill it — no permission required. Every decision is an experiment: we run it, let the results decide, and drive real impact from day one.

 

About Vitalize's Enterprise Solutions Team

Our customers operate complex technology environments spanning workforce management, HR, payroll, EHRs, identity, security, and other enterprise systems. As Vitalize takes on larger health systems and expands what our platform can do, the technical complexity of selling, deploying, and supporting our product grows with it.

Enterprise Solutions exists to make that complexity scalable. The function bridges Growth and Post-Sales — ensuring we understand what's technically possible before we sell it, customers are technically ready to go live, and the hardest problems we encounter become repeatable solutions the broader team can own. Done well, Enterprise Solutions helps us activate revenue faster, make deployments more predictable, and scale to increasingly complex customers without scaling technical support linearly.

The Role

You’ll be one of the first two Enterprise Solutions hires at Vitalize, building the function from scratch alongside a peer focused on workforce and payroll systems. Together you’ll define what Enterprise Solutions becomes as our customer base and Post-Sales organization grow.

You’ll own the clinical systems that tell a hospital how much care it needs to staff for: EHRs (Epic, Oracle Health, Meditech, and similar), the interface engines around them, and adjacent acuity and assignment tools. Today that means real-time census, ADT, and acuity data that drives staffing decisions. As Vitalize expands into patient flow and capacity management, your scope grows with it.

Success means EHR integrations that are feasible, secure, and repeatable; deployments that aren’t stalled by interface-team backlogs or security reviews; and a team that becomes increasingly self-sufficient on clinical data because the hardest problems you solve become playbooks, tools, and repeatable capabilities.

What You’ll Do

  • Own clinical-data solutioning across the customer lifecycle: Bridge Growth and Post-Sales so that what we sell can be deployed and supported, carrying critical technical context from pre-signature discovery through implementation and post-launch

  • Lead EHR discovery on enterprise deals: Partner with Growth before commitments are made to understand EHR vendor and version, interface engine (Epic Bridges, Rhapsody, Cloverleaf, Mirth, or similar), available feeds (HL7 v2 ADT, FHIR, vendor APIs), where acuity and assignment data lives, interface-team capacity, and security and privacy requirements

  • Get hospital interface and security teams to “yes”: Scope the smallest useful feed, minimize the patient data we take in, and guide integrations through security, privacy, and compliance review

  • Partner with Deployments to drive clinical-data readiness: Set the standards for unit and department mapping, feed testing, and census validation against what managers actually see. Step into complex deployments where needed while enabling Deployment Strategists to own increasingly sophisticated workstreams

  • Grow our footprint into flow and capacity: As Vitalize expands into patient flow and capacity management, extend our EHR integrations into bed management, transfers, ED boarding, and discharge planning data

  • Build technical leverage across Vitalize: Create reusable EHR integration patterns, discovery guides, documentation, and training. Partner with Product on when to go through an EHR vendor marketplace versus a direct interface

  • Turn customer requirements into product signal: Identify recurring clinical-data requirements and blockers across our pipeline and customer base. Partner with Product and Engineering to decide when the answer is better enablement, a new integration, or a scalable platform capability

What You’ll Bring

  • Hands-on EHR integration experience: You’ve integrated with or implemented a major EHR (Epic, Oracle Health, Meditech, or similar), for example as an Epic analyst, interface engineer, or clinical integration architect

  • Interoperability fluency: HL7 v2 (especially ADT), FHIR, interface engines, and the realities of hospital interface-team backlogs and change control

  • Security and privacy instincts: Working knowledge of HIPAA, minimizing PHI, BAAs, and healthcare security reviews

  • You can lead technical solutioning with enterprise customers: You’re comfortable with CIO organizations, clinical informatics, interface teams, and security teams, from pre-sales through implementation and escalation

  • You create leverage, not dependency: Your instinct after solving a difficult problem is to turn the solution into something others can repeat

  • You know when Engineering is needed and when it isn’t: You can distinguish implementation issues, configuration problems, integration limitations, and true product gaps

  • You can bridge GTM and Post-Sales: You know how to advance a complex enterprise deal without creating promises the delivery team can’t keep

  • You want to build something from zero: You’re excited to define a new function, not inherit one

  • Clinical operations context is a major plus: You understand how census, ADT, and acuity drive nurse staffing ratios and patient assignments, or you’ve worked with patient flow and capacity tools (bed boards, transfer centers, capacity command centers)

Logistics

  • Location: Anywhere in the US with 40–50% travel to customer sites. If you’re SF-based and want a hybrid setup, you’re welcome to work from our HQ in Jackson Square

  • Reports to: COO

 

Benefits

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Flexible PTO

  • Unlimited travel budget to visit customer sites

  • Bi-annual company off-sites

  • Free meals in-office

  • $5,000 relocation bonus for eligible employees

  • Desk setup reimbursement

  • Commuter benefits

  • Monthly gym/wellness stipend

  • An awesome office in Jackson Square, steps from the water

These are the systems of record Vitalize reads from and writes back to — schedules, punches, pay codes, accruals, org hierarchies, and employee data. Getting them right decides whether a deployment goes live on time and whether a nurse's incentive pay lands correctly on her paycheck.

Success means fewer deployments delayed by workforce-system readiness, tighter alignment between what Growth sells and what Post-Sales can deliver, and a team that becomes increasingly self-sufficient on UKG, Workday, and payroll work because the hardest problems you solve become playbooks, tools, and repeatable capabilities.

What You’ll Do

  • Own workforce-system solutioning across the customer lifecycle: Bridge Growth and Post-Sales so that what we sell can be deployed and supported, carrying critical technical context from pre-signature discovery through implementation and post-launch

  • Lead WFM, HCM, and payroll discovery on enterprise deals: Partner with Growth before commitments are made to understand tenant and version, degree of customization, API vs. file-based integration options, pay rules, labor-level and cost-center structures, which system owns which data, SSO and provisioning, and customer-side responsibilities

  • Partner with Deployments to drive integration readiness: Set the standards for pay code, job code, and org mapping; integration setup; testing; payroll validation; and cutover. Step into complex deployments where needed while enabling Deployment Strategists to own increasingly sophisticated workstreams

  • Step in after go-live when deeper expertise is required: Diagnose sync failures, pay discrepancies, and customer-side upgrades or migrations (e.g., Workforce Central → Dimensions), and get to root cause fast

  • Build technical leverage across Vitalize: Create vendor-specific playbooks, discovery guides, documentation, and training so Growth, Deployments, Support, and Customer Success can handle standard UKG, Workday, and payroll workflows on their own

  • Turn customer requirements into product signal: Identify recurring workforce-integration requirements and blockers across our pipeline and customer base. Partner with Product and Engineering to decide when the answer is better enablement, a new integration, or a scalable platform capability

What You’ll Bring

  • Deep, hands-on WFM or HCM expertise: You’ve worked inside at least one major workforce management, HCM, or payroll platform (UKG, Workday, Oracle, Infor, API Healthcare, or similar), ideally as an implementation consultant, solutions architect, or integration lead

  • You understand how time becomes pay: You know timekeeping, scheduling, accruals, pay rules, labor levels, and org hierarchies, how they flow into payroll, and where they break

  • Integration fluency: REST APIs, SFTP and flat-file integrations, middleware (Boomi, Workday EIB/Studio, UKG integration tooling, or similar), SSO (SAML/OIDC), and provisioning (SCIM)

  • You can lead technical solutioning with enterprise customers: You’re comfortable with CIO organizations, HRIS and payroll leaders, integration teams, and security teams, from pre-sales through implementation and escalation

  • You can bridge GTM and Post-Sales: You know how to advance a complex enterprise deal without creating promises the delivery team can’t keep

  • You want to build something from zero: You’re excited to define a new function, not inherit one

  • Health system experience is a major plus: Especially healthcare pay practices, such as shift differentials, call and premium pay, incentive pay, and union rules
